title: 312 events. Where did it start?
lines: When hundreds of alarms fire together, the first cause gets buried.
TripLens reconstructs the incident behind the noise.

title: Detect → investigate → intervene → learn
lines: For process engineers, TripLens connects eighteen observed channels, two control loops, and a branching process graph.
Twelve incident sessions put different fault hypotheses to the test.

title: Observed signals in. Inspectable evidence out.
lines: Here, cooling demand rises, but valve feedback stays low.
Flow falls, and reactor temperature follows.
Compare competing causes, including the evidence against each one.
Rewind the investigation to see only what was known at that moment.

title: A sensor fault is not a process fault.
lines: A second session tells a different story: a frozen pressure sensor.
Independent channels keep moving.
TripLens flags the bad measurement and excludes it from strong process evidence.

title: 312 events → 6 conditions → 3 process groups
lines: The cooling-valve incident produces three hundred twelve events, six unique conditions, and three process groups.
Activations, repeated annunciations, and returns remain inspectable.

title: 1,547 branches. Find the last recoverable second.
lines: Now ask what could still prevent the trip.
TripLens fits the leading hypothesis, then computes seven interventions across fifteen hundred forty-seven branches.
For the cooling bypass, one hundred one seconds is the last safe start in this model window.
One second later, pressure crosses the limit.
Emergency cooling buys two more seconds. A backup pump cannot resolve this stuck valve.

title: Inputs. Outputs. Evidence. A complete trail.
lines: Every investigation step exposes its inputs and calculated output.
Controller behavior, competing hypotheses, and procedure preconditions remain visible.
Export the full root-cause dossier, including uncertainty and counterfactual results.

title: Incident memory + verification + alarm improvement
lines: Save the incident fingerprint and operator note.
Retrieve similar sessions, review repeated alarms, and inspect thirty-six internal parameter variants.
These checks are simulator regressions, not independent industrial validation.
New signal windows can enter through CSV.

title: Structured investigation. Deterministic verification.
lines: Native Python computes the evidence and verifies interventions.
A structured interface is prepared for NVIDIA Nemotron through Nebius Token Factory.
This recording uses the local investigation policy; live provider integration is pending.

title: Follow the evidence. Change the outcome.
lines: From alarm floods to an investigation you can inspect, challenge, and replay.
TripLens. Follow the evidence. Change the outcome.
